subtitle: Demo controls for presenters. All data is synthetic and stays in this browser.
everyRole: Every demo role can use these controls — demo tooling, not a privilege. Each action is recorded in the audit log.

reset.title: Reset demo
reset.body: This restores the synthetic baseline, audit log and demo clock. Changes made during the demo are removed.
reset.confirmTitle: Reset the demo to its baseline?
reset.failedTitle: The demo could not be reset

language.title: Language
language.body: Choose the portal language. The choice is saved in this browser and survives a reload and a demo reset.

faults.title: Fault simulation
faults.body: Simulate transport problems to demonstrate error states. Faults are saved with the demo data and cleared by Reset demo.
faults.latencyHint: Added to every repository call (0–3000 ms).
faults.timeoutHint: Saves complete but the response is lost; retrying with the same request is safe.
faults.serverErrorHint: Every repository call fails with a server error before it runs.
faults.offlineHint: Every repository call fails as if the network were down.
faults.conflictHint: The next save to a WF-01, WF-02 or WF-03 scenario record, or the next amendment of the amended or missing-unit demo screening, reports a version conflict.
faults.offlineBanner: Simulated offline — changes cannot be saved

scenario.title: Scenario actions
scenario.body: Stage moments of the demo workflows. Actions by other people are simulated and labelled as such.
scenario.wf02Missing: The WF-02 follow-up belongs to Demo Health Centre Alpha-1. Switch to that facility to use this action.
scenario.simulateWf02Hint: Saves a new version of the WF-02 follow-up as a simulated community health worker, so the next save in the portal shows a version conflict.
scenario.simulatedDone: Follow-up updated by a simulated worker (version {{version}})
